physical: The greatest rate at which information can be sent reliably through a noisy channel is the bandwidth times the log of one plus the signal-to-noise ratio. (C = B × log(1 + S ÷ N))

interpretation: Collection in Vibrational Reality has no partner for channel capacity, bandwidth, or noise in the frozen table.
